description: Figure 3 illustrates the number of targeted and untargeted datasets over the years 2012 through 2022, alongside the distribution of data sources. The horizontal axis represents the year, labeled linearly from 2012 to 2022, with each year representing a category. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Two sets of bars are presented for each year: “Targets” bars, colored orange, and “Untargeted” bars, colored blue. In 2012, the “Targets” bar reaches approximately 20, while the “Untargeted” bar reaches approximately 100. By 2022, the “Targets” bar reaches approximately 120, and the “Untargeted” bar reaches approximately 40. A third set of bars, representing “Data sources”, is displayed below the year labels, with each bar segmented into different colors representing the proportion of datasets from various sources. The “Data sources” bars are not sorted and are visually arranged to show the composition of datasets for each year. The bars are not visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
